verdict.rationale: CIPO is a government intellectual-property office offering filing portals, search databases and bulk data. It is not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client and consume tools from plugged-in MCP servers, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any MCP-client or agent capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
